profile_text.body:
Procare Solutions describes itself as a leader in child care management software, saying its product simplifies child care program operations so staff can focus on the children. The company says its data model is based on experience working with over 100,000 child care centers, before and after school programs and youth. It also runs an annual survey of early education, which this year focuses on AI and how it is reshaping early childhood education and leadership; respondents are entered to win 1 of 6 Apple iPads.

The company's tracked product is Procare, listed under education and research AI, with child care management as its use and early childhood programs and families as its audience. The record notes that AI features are not verified and that the product was found in research for The AI Ready School and not independently verified. Pricing is quote-based, and the record notes that one competitor reports plans from $69/month, a competitor source to treat cautiously.

No litigation, SEC filings, patents, or MCP servers appear in the material.
